title: Tsung Woo Sz Zen Wei

page_data.en:
No
407
26/6/16.
Shanghai Municipal Council.
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL POLICE FORCE JUNCTA）
POLICE FORCE,
(DETECTIVE BRANCH)
June 22nd 1916.

Sir,
The Socialistic meeting announced to take place
in Tsung Woo Sz Zen Wei 中華旅義館 No.135 North Chekiang
Road yesterday afternoon had to be abandoned, as only
four persons attended.
The Kuomintang party in Shanghai intends to
send a representative to Peking within the next few
days in order to try to come to an agreement with
the Government.
A memorial service in honour of Yuan Shih Kai
will be held in the Arsenal this morning.
Fifteen boxes, containing 6 small machine guns
and 300 rounds of ammunition were sent from the Arsenal
to Peking by the S.N.R. on 21st instant.
A man named Tsung, a native of Chekiang was
arrested on his arrival here by train yesterday.
A quantity of old brass, including 12 shell cases,
was found in his possession.
Sun Pao Chi 孫寶琦 Minister of Finance arrived
in Shanghai from Peking at 7 a.m. 22nd inst.
Five German missionaries who were captured
when Japan took over the German islands in the south
seas, arrived here from Nagasaki by the s.s. Hakuai
Maru on 21st inst.

Your Obedient Servant,
（签名）
Chief Detective Inspector.

（批：OK）
Captain Superintendent of Police.

（手写批注：Interested or not?）
page_data.zh:
编号
407
1916年6月26日。
上海工部局。
（印：上海工部局警务处联合档案）
警务处，
（侦探股）
1916年6月22日。

先生：

原定于昨日下午在浙江北路135号中华旅义馆举行的社会主义者集会，因仅有四人出席，被迫取消。

上海国民党方面打算在近几日内派遣一名代表前往北京，以期与政府达成协议。

为纪念袁世凯而举行的追悼会将于今晨在兵工厂举行。

本月21日，兵工厂经由南满铁路（S.N.R.）向北京发送了十五箱货物，内含6挺小型机枪及300发子弹。

一名姓宗（Tsung，音译）的浙江籍男子，于昨日乘火车抵达本站时被捕。

在其身上搜出大量旧黄铜，其中包括12个弹壳。

财政总长孙宝琦于本月22日上午7时由北京抵达上海。

五名德国传教士在日本接管南洋德属岛屿时被俘，他们于本月21日乘坐“博爱丸”号轮船（s.s. Hakuai Maru）从长崎抵达此处。

您忠实的仆人，
（签名）
总探长。

（批：阅）
警务处处长。

（手写批注：是否感兴趣？）
